snapshot.title: FastVideo FastH3: Text to Video
snapshot.description: Generate synchronized video and audio directly from text using a distilled eight-step model, producing one video output with no file inputs required. Ideal for rapid text-to-video prototyping, audio-visual content creation, and creative storytelling where fast generation matters more than maximum detail.

snapshot.title: Hunyuan Video 1.5 Text to Video
snapshot.description: Generate high-quality 720p videos from text prompts with cinematic camera control, emotional expressions, and physics simulation. Supports multiple styles including realistic, anime, and 3D with text rendering.

snapshot.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Video
snapshot.description: Generate video with native stereo audio directly from a text prompt using MiniMax H3, an omni-modal model that synthesizes voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and roughly 15 seconds long, with no file inputs required — just a prompt to one video output. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, social media content creation, and audio-synced storytelling.

snapshot.title: Wan 2.2 14B Text to Video
snapshot.description: Generate high-quality videos from text prompts with cinematic aesthetic control and dynamic motion generation using Wan 2.2.

snapshot.title: Ideogram v4 Int8: Text to Image
snapshot.description: Generate images from text prompts using the Ideogram v4 model, a state-of-the-art open-weight text-to-image system with exceptional text rendering and layout control. No file inputs are required, producing 1 image output. Ideal for creating marketing visuals, generating design mockups with precise typography, and producing high-resolution artwork with controlled compositions.

snapshot.title: Krea-2 Int8: Text to Image
snapshot.description: Generate images with the Krea-2 Turbo distilled text-to-image model using the high-performance Int8 Convrot format, which delivers better quality than FP8 while generally running faster across most GPUs. This workflow accepts no file inputs and produces a single image output, with optional style LoRA support for creative customization. Ideal for rapid concept art iteration, batch asset generation for games or marketing, and exploring the speed-quality sweet spot of the Convrot Int8 quantization.

snapshot.title: Qwen Image 2.1: Text to Image
snapshot.description: Generate images from text prompts with Qwen Image 2.1, the latest open-weight Qwen-Image model, producing a single 1024×1024 image over 25 sampling steps. Generation and instruction-based editing share one model with native 2K output, professional typography, and alpha-channel support. Ideal for poster and layout design, transparent asset creation, and rapid concept visualization.

snapshot.title: Z-Image-Turbo: Text to Image
snapshot.description: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer, supports English & Chinese.

snapshot.title: ACE-Step 1.5XL Turbo: Text to Music
snapshot.description: Generate high-quality music from text prompts using the distilled 4B ACE-Step model. Produces commercial-ready audio in just 8 inference steps without CFG.

snapshot.title: MiniMax Music 3: Text to Music
snapshot.description: Create full-length songs from text prompts with MiniMax Music 3, generating complete 5-minute tracks with stable structure and high-fidelity audio. Input a structured caption describing lyrics, style, mood, and arrangement, and receive a finished song as output. Ideal for music producers prototyping demos, and content creators needing original background tracks.

snapshot.title: Stable Audio 3.0 Medium
snapshot.description: Input a short text idea, optional duration, seed, and category. Generate stereo audio (music, SFX, or instruments) using Stable Audio 3 with optional AI-driven text expansion.

snapshot.title: YuE2: Text to Music
snapshot.description: Generate complete songs from a music style and lyrics with YuE2. Use symbolic music planning to create structured melodies and harmonies, then turn them into full songs with vocals and instrumental accompaniment.
